reader.name: Reader
reader.job: Reads each 10-K's income statement and cash-flow statement and returns revenue, cost of revenue (or its cost lines), operating income and capex for every year shown, each pointing at the cell it came from.
decides: Which row of the statement is each field
Which lines are a cost of revenue when there is no total line
The period of each column, and the unit to apply
checked_by: Every citation must resolve to the exact cell in the parsed table, or the answer is rejected and asked again once
Chrome re-reads every cited cell on the rendered 10-K
16 rules, the SEC's XBRL answer key, and a fault test of planted mistakes

ai_reader.name: AI spend reader
ai_reader.job: Reads the MD&A passages of each 10-K that mention AI next to capital or operating spending and returns every statement of how much goes to AI: a dollar amount, a share, or words only, each a verbatim quote.
decides: Whether a sentence states an amount, a share, or only words
Whether the figure is the AI part or the company's total with AI as a driver
Which fiscal year a sentence speaks to, and whether it is the reported year or an outlook
checked_by: Every quote must be a verbatim sentence of the passage it cites, or the answer is rejected and asked again once
An AI amount above the company's own capex for that year is a warning

decides: Which note table holds each fact
What each segment or category is called, verbatim
Whether a column is a fiscal year or a year-end balance

projects_reader.name: Projects reader
projects_reader.job: Reads the passages of each text that name a project with a size and returns every named project the company is building, buying or contracting for the AI buildout: kind, stage, size, dates, counterparty, each a verbatim quote.
decides: Whether a sentence names a project or only a total or an intention
The project's kind and stage from the words used
Which size, date and counterparty the sentence states, and nothing it does not
checked_by: Every quote must be a verbatim sentence of the passage it cites, or the answer is rejected and asked again once
Amounts, capacity, GPU counts and dates must be in range or null
The loader keeps the newest mention per project, so a project shows once at its latest status

mapper.name: Mapper
mapper.job: For a company's reported PP&E categories with no entry in taxonomy/asset_types.yaml, proposes the nearest us-gaap PropertyPlantAndEquipmentByTypeAxis member with the note's own words as evidence and a confidence; a person approves, edits or rejects each on Reconcile.
decides: Which member on the allowed list is nearest to what the note says the category holds
Which words of the note are the evidence
How sure the note's words allow it to be: high, medium or low
checked_by: Every proposal names a category the task asked for, a member on the list (or none) and evidence that is words of the task, or the answer is rejected and asked again once
Nothing it proposes is a mapping until a person approves it; the approval refuses a member off the list and a duplicate entry
Guard asset_type_mapping on the Proof board counts a category mapped only after the approval
